instruction: Apply underlining to the title text in the selected slide.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining the title text in the active slide. The custom getter identifies the title shape using placeholder type (PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE or CENTERED_TITLE) and verifies that ALL text runs in the title are underlined. The metric compares the result against the expected underline status (true).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly identifies title shape using PP_PLACEHOLDER.TITLE or PP_PLACEHOLDER.CENTERED_TITLE (getters/pptx.py:36-41), with fallback to first text shape
Complete verification logic: checks that ALL text runs in the title are underlined using proper all_underlined flag (getters/pptx.py:53-64)
Metric parameter handling is correct for type='rule' - expected IS the rules dict, accessed directly with expected.get('is_underlined') (metrics/pptx.py:15)
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to persist formatting changes
Edge cases handled: returns False for empty slides, no title shape, no text runs
Evaluator can semantically and logically verify that all title text is underlined as required by the instruction
